title: EN 301 549 V4.1.0: Accessibility requirements for ICT products and services
status: Final draft, under approval — not yet a published standard
statusBody: This version may change. Use the official ETSI PDF as the source of record.
sourceOrganisation: ETSI (European Telecommunications Standards Institute), in collaboration with CEN and CENELEC
sourcePdfPublicationDateNote: The source PDF's cover page prints only a year and month, not a specific day.
dateDownloadedNote: Taken from this repository's git history (the commit that first added the source PDF), not independently verified against ETSI's own records.
statusLastCheckedNote: The date someone genuinely checked ETSI's publication/approval status for this standard (not a build timestamp — the build never sets this automatically). Currently the same as the date downloaded, above, because downloading the PDF was itself that check. Update it only when a maintainer has actually re-checked the status — for example by visiting the ETSI deliverable page linked from this page and confirming whether the version or approval status has changed — and record what you found in docs-for-maintainers/maintenance.md's change notes. Never advance this date without doing the check; the build rejects missing, malformed, future-dated, or placeholder-looking values here.
sha256Note: Computed directly from the PDF committed at docs/source/en_301549v040100va.pdf with the sha256sum command. Recompute and update this value whenever the source PDF is replaced.
siteBuildDateNote: Intentionally left empty. The build does not stamp a live timestamp into generated pages, so that rebuilding from unchanged source always produces identical output (see README). Set this manually if a fixed ‘last rebuilt’ date is wanted after a real content update.
